content.text: /ext:medcp Pick a commonly used anti-TNF therapy and report how many RA patients received it.
I'll pick a common anti-TNF therapy (adalimumab) and query the EHR database for RA patients who received it. Let me first look at the available tables.
This is an OMOP CDM database. Adalimumab is a commonly used anti-TNF therapy. Let me find its concept and count distinct RA patients (rheumatoid arthritis) who received it.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE lower(concept_name) LIKE '%adalimumab%'
  AND domain_id = 'Drug'
  AND standard_concept = 'S'
ORDER BY concept_name
LIMIT 50;

Rather than enumerate every pack/branded formulation, I'll use the OMOP `concept_ancestor` table to capture all adalimumab descendants (all forms/brands/biosimilars) under the ingredient, and count distinct RA patients. Let me get the ingredient concept and RA condition concepts.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE lower(concept_name) = 'adalimumab'
  AND concept_class_id = 'Ingredient';

content.text: Adalimumab ingredient concept is `1119119`. Now I'll count distinct RA patients who received any adalimumab drug (all descendants via `concept_ancestor`), where RA is standard SNOMED "Rheumatoid arthritis" and its descendants.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS ra_patients_on_adalimumab
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_drug
  ON de.drug_concept_id = ca_drug.descendant_concept_id
 AND ca_drug.ancestor_concept_id = 1119119   -- adalimumab ingredient
WHERE de.person_id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_cond
    ON co.condition_concept_id = ca_cond.descendant_concept_id
   AND ca_cond.ancestor_concept_id = 80809   -- Rheumatoid arthritis (SNOMED)
);

content.text:
**Adalimumab (Humira) — 925 RA patients** received it in this database.

Method: counted distinct patients with any adalimumab drug exposure (ingredient concept `1119119`, including all brands/biosimilars/formulations via OMOP `concept_ancestor`) who also had a rheumatoid arthritis diagnosis (SNOMED `80809` and descendants).
